items.title: Pay outstanding balance for dining furniture (2nd reminder)
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie dringend, den Gesamtbetrag bis Freitag, 11.12.2026 zu begleichen.
items.computation: The letter explicitly states the payment deadline as Friday, 11.12.2026. Checked: 11 December 2026 does fall on a Friday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed. The due date is taken directly as printed.

warnings: This is the second reminder (2. Mahnung) from a private furniture retailer, not a public authority; if the original invoice or delivery (15.10.2026) is disputed, double-check the goods were actually received as billed before paying.

The letter threatens to hand the claim to a debt collection agency (Inkassounternehmen) with costs at the recipient's expense if payment is not received by the deadline — this is a standard but pressuring dunning tactic; verify the amount and bank details independently before transferring money.
